title: TotalSegmentator
description: Segment organs, bones, vertebrae and muscles in 3D CT and MRI with TotalSegmentator v2.

segment.title: Run segmentation
segment.description: Return a multilabel anatomical segmentation mask in the input scan's geometry and a TSV table of per-structure volumes and intensities.

image.description: 3D CT or MRI volume (NIfTI .nii/.nii.gz or DICOM series)

task.description: Segmentation task: total (CT, 117 classes), total_mr (MRI, 50 classes), vertebrae_mr (MRI, 25 classes), or abdominal_muscles (CT, 22 classes).

resolution.description: Model resolution for total and total_mr: fast (3 mm single model, default) or full (1.5 mm multi-part). Omit or pass full for vertebrae_mr and abdominal_muscles.

subset.description: Structure group when running total (1.5 mm) or total_mr (1.5 mm). For total_mr, valid subsets are all, muscles, and organs.

backend.description: Requested inference backend; WebGPU failures fall back to WASM CPU.
